items.title: 7.6 Data science aur tajzie mein akhlaqi masail (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethical issues in data science (PDF 101-102).

blocks.text: Akhlaqi masail data science mein bari fikr hain. Jab data bare paimane par jama aur tajzia hota hai to use zimmedari se sambhalna zaroori hai: akhlaqi amal faislon ko munsifana, durust aur qabil-e-bharosa rakhta, jab ke kamzor miyar data ke ghalat istemal aur afraad ya groups ke nuqsan tak le ja sakte hain. Data scientists ko data jama, process aur tashreeh karte hue akhlaqi rehnuma usool par chalna chahiye, har marhale par shaffafiyat aur jawabdehi ke saath.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Janibdar (biased) data na-insafi wale nataij de sakta hai; akhlaqi data science raazdari bachati, imtiyazi sulook se bachati aur technology par bharosa banati hai.
Data jama karne aur tajzie mein bias

Data jama karne mein bias tab hota hai jab data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi na kare, maslan mehdood zaraye ya na-munsifana namoona bandi se; tajzie ke dauran zaati mafroozat bhi bias la sakte hain. Janibdar data ghalat, gumraah-kun nataij deta hai jo na-insafi ko barha sakte hain, is liye bias ko ehtiyat se jama karne aur ghair-janibdar tajzie se pehchanna aur kam karna zaroori hai.

blocks.caption: Bias ki misalein
rows: Talaba ki karkardagi ka survey sirf behtareen schools mein, darmiyane aur kamzor schools nazar-andaz
Sehat ki tehqeeq mein sirf jawan log, is liye nataij buzurgon ki numaindagi nahi karte
Bharti ke dataset mein zyada tar mard umeedwar, is liye us par train hua model mardon ko tarjeeh deta
Sirf shehri ilaqon ka data dehi logon ke faislon ke liye use
Researcher sirf apne khayal ki tayeed wala data dekhta aur mukhalif nataij nazar-andaz karta

blocks.text: Data aur models ka akhlaqi istemal

items: Raazdari aur poshidgi ka ehtram; data sirf munasib ijazat se jama aur sirf bayan kiye maqsad ke liye use.
Machine learning models imtiyazi sulook se bachne ke liye design karein.
Hassas data ko be-ijazat rasai se bachayein.
Predictive models ke ghalat istemal se bachne ke liye akhlaqi usool par chalein, aur models ke kaam ke baare mein shaffaf rahein, jis se bharosa banta.

blocks.text: Nataij imandari se, mubalighe ya hera-pheri ke baghair pesh karne chahiye; data aur tajzie ki hudood wazeh batani chahiye; aur gumraah-kun tasaveer ya chuninda reporting se bachna chahiye. Wazeh, sachi wazahat logon ko nataij durust samajhne, ghalat istemal rokne aur data tajzie par bharosa mazboot karne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Chehra pehchanne wala system zyada tar gori rangat ke balighon ki tasaveer par train hua. Yeh kis qism ka bias hai, aur kya nuqsan ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sampling bias: data tamam groups ki numaindagi nahi karta. System saanwli rangat walon ya bachon ko kam durust pehchan sakta hai, jis se ghalat shanakht ya rasai se inkar ho sakta hai; hal zyada numainda training data aur har group ke liye testing hai.

items: Data zimmedari se: insaf, durusti, shaffafiyat, jawabdehi.
Bias ki qismein: survey, sampling, gender, geographical, confirmation.
Akhlaqi istemal: ijazat, raazdari, imtiyaz nahi; hudood ke saath imandar reporting.
